build.buildCommand: composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader --no-scripts && rm -f bootstrap/cache/packages.php bootstrap/cache/services.php && npm ci && npm run build

deploy.startCommand: rm -f bootstrap/cache/packages.php bootstrap/cache/services.php && php artisan migrate --force && node /assets/scripts/prestart.mjs /assets/nginx.template.conf /nginx.conf && (php-fpm -y /assets/php-fpm.conf & nginx -c /nginx.conf)
